title: cnidium multicaule
intro: Cnidium multicaule, commonly known as Shepherd's Needle, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and anti-bacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cnidium multicaule include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-arthritic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkylphosphocholine, apiol, and sesquiterpenes. The health benefits of Cnidium multicaule include pain relief, improved joint mobility, and enhanced immune function.
